name: Investigation
overview: Scripture presents investigation as a diligent pursuit of wisdom and understanding, as seen in Ecclesiastes where the preacher earnestly seeks to comprehend all that is done under heaven. Yet, this search reveals the limitations of human effort and knowledge, highlighting the vanity and frustration inherent in worldly pursuits. The quest for wisdom brings with it an awareness of life's complexities and imperfections, leading to sorrow and grief as one recognizes that some things cannot be made right or fully grasped.
